title: JuicyPixels: Out-of-bounds writes in BMP RLE and TIFF strip decoding
description: JuicyPixels versions from 3.1.3 up to but not including 3.3.10 contain out-of-bounds write vulnerabilities in BMP RLE and TIFF strip decoding. These flaws allow heap memory corruption via crafted image files, potentially leading to crashes or remote code execution under certain conditions. The issue is fixed in version 3.3.10.
